approval_status: STUDENT JUDGMENT BASE-CASE PROPOSAL — implemented for transparent model testing; not a sourced forecast, investment recommendation, or final approval.
monetary_units: USD millions, except per-share values and percentages

financing_policy.mechanism: Automatic year-end draw on the disclosed 2025 revolving credit facility/commercial-paper backstop only to restore cash to the stated floor. No assumed accordion, equity issuance, capex reduction, or dividend reduction.

decision_analysis.market_implied_enterprise_value_status: PROVISIONAL — derived from the unresolved Yahoo Finance $97.87 regular-close observation and July 23, 2026 basic shares; do not use for a final market-price-dependent decision.

reporting.decision_user: Hypothetical buy-side long-only U.S. equity fund investment committee
reporting.source_cutoff: Public information available by U.S. market close, 4:00 PM Eastern Time, on 2026-10-19
reporting.action: No final committee action — draft model output only; market-price evidence remains unresolved.
reporting.conditions: Use only after the student reviews all forecast judgments and resolves the conflict in the dated market-price evidence.
reporting.reversal_trigger: Any failure of reconciliation, material change in primary-source operating evidence, or resolution of the dated-price conflict that changes the comparison basis.
reporting.limitations: All forecast and valuation parameters are student judgments. The market price and market-implied EV are provisional; valuation-date bridge amounts are based on the 2026-06-28 interim balance sheet; basic shares are as of 2026-07-23.
reporting.material_inputs: See assumptions metadata, docs/assumption-challenge-record.md, and docs/source-ledger.md. Per-share denominator is basic common shares outstanding, not fully diluted shares.

controls.label: Year 1 capex (% of revenue)
controls.basis: Approved base 6.20%; envelope spans Year 1 low/high scenario cases 6.50% and 6.00%.

controls.label: Year 1 revenue growth (%)
controls.basis: Approved base 0.0%; endpoints match the documented Year 1 low and high causal case assumptions.

controls.label: Year 1 gross margin (% of revenue)
controls.basis: Approved base 68.50%; endpoints match the documented Year 1 low and high causal case assumptions.

revenue_growth.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: 0.0%, 1.0%, 2.0%, 2.5%, 3.0% starts below the FY2025 negative global comparable-sales result and allows only gradual recovery; direct growth is used because a revenue-component historical split is not verified.

gross_margin.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: base begins near FY2025 reported gross margin and permits only 25bp annual improvement.

operating_expense_pct_revenue.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: base declines 50bp annually from the FY2025 expense ratio; no specific cost-savings fact is assumed.

working_capital.units: % of stated revenue, cost-of-sales, or operating-expense driver
working_capital.evidence: H-BS-AR, H-BS-INV, H-BS-OCA, H-BS-AP, H-BS-ACCR, H-IS-REV, H-IS-COS, H-IS-OPEX
working_capital.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: retain FY2025 derived ratios, rounded, because five-year detailed operating-balance drivers are not otherwise approved.
working_capital.low_base_high_bounds: No scenario variation proposed: AR 3.44% of revenue; inventory 18.75% of cost of sales; other current assets 1.22% of revenue; AP 15.89% of cost of sales; accrued liabilities 10.33% of operating expenses.

capex_pct_revenue.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: base moves from the FY2025 capex/revenue ratio toward 5.5%; no store-build program is asserted. Sensitivity is plus/minus 10% of each base percentage, not percentage points.

depreciation_pct_beginning_net_ppe.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: base begins near FY2025 cash-flow D&A divided by net PP&E and modestly declines; D&A add-back is a proxy rather than an asset-life schedule.

tax_rate.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: 26.0% approximates FY2025 reported tax expense divided by model pretax income; it is not a cash-tax fact.
tax_rate.low_base_high_bounds: 22.0% / 26.0% / 30.0% for low/base/high tax-rate review; no case override proposed.

interest_expense.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: hold FY2025 interest expense flat while net debt issuance is zero; no rate or maturity forecast is asserted.
interest_expense.low_base_high_bounds: Review range $500m to $600m annually; base $542.6m annually.

non_operating_income_expense.units: USD millions per year; positive is income/gain and negative is expense/loss
non_operating_income_expense.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: historical equity-investee income, asset-sale/divestiture gains, interest income, and other non-operating items are not assumed to recur without separate evidence.
non_operating_income_expense.low_base_high_bounds: Base is $0.0 for all years; no alternate case entered without separately supported evidence.

short_term_investments.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: hold latest eligible interim balance flat and outside operating NWC; this is a timing proxy, not a forecast fact.

other_noncurrent_assets_and_other_liabil.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: hold both FY2025 model aggregates flat. Equal changes are required by the current simplified model to preserve articulation; no component forecast is implied.
other_noncurrent_assets_and_other_liabil.low_base_high_bounds: No scenario variation proposed pending component-level evidence.

net_debt_issuance_and_dividends.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: set net debt issuance to zero because the historical cash-flow debt-component sign issue remains unresolved; hold FY2025 cash dividends flat solely as a neutral mechanical assumption.
net_debt_issuance_and_dividends.low_base_high_bounds: Debt issuance review range -$1,000m to +$1,000m; dividend review range $0m to $2,771.4m annually; no case override proposed.

financing_policy.evidence: S-010 Note 8 pp. 22–24 and Liquidity pp. 51–52
financing_policy.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: retain a $1,000m minimum cash balance. If pre-financing year-end cash is below that floor, draw only the disclosed $3,000m committed revolver/commercial-paper capacity. Incremental interest begins in the following year at a 5.0% proxy rate; the filing specifies Term SOFR plus a ratings-based margin but not a usable all-in forecast rate. No reduction in dividends or capex is assumed.
financing_policy.low_base_high_bounds: Minimum cash $500m / $1,000m / $1,500m; committed draw cap $3,000m; rate review 4.0% / 5.0% / 6.0%. Capacity excess produces a visible failed minimum-cash check rather than an invented funding source.

valuation_bridge.units: WACC/terminal growth in %; claims/assets in USD millions; common shares in millions
valuation_bridge.evidence: V-CASH-2026Q3, V-STI-2026Q3, V-DEBT-2026Q3, V-LEASE-2026Q3, V-NCI-2026Q3, V-OMC-2026Q3, V-NOA-2026Q3, V-SHARES-2026Q3, V-PRICE-2026-10-19
valuation_bridge.rationale: STUDENT JUDGMENT: 9.0% WACC and 2.5% terminal growth are provisional model parameters, not sourced market facts. Basic shares of 1,140.0m are used. The market-implied EV uses the unresolved Yahoo close only for a clearly labeled reverse-DCF output.
